title: Remove C418
description: Remove C418's music from the game
body:
## It's okay to dislike C418's music!

So this resourcepack provides more options. Please note: this resource pack is still in early access. You may still hear C418’s music while playing, it is because the pack only covers the main menu, credits, plains biome, and creative mode, it works best in creative mode for now.

**A quick way to check if it’s working is to open the credits, if you hear “Lilypad” instead of “Alpha” by C418, that means the resourcepack is working correctly.**

## How does it work?
This resource pack didn’t modify anything in the game. Instead, it provides a music list json that doesn’t include C418’s music. If you’d like to improve or complete this pack, check out the links below, you are welcome to distribute, modify, and publish this resource pack however you want, there is no restrictions.

Wiki: [https://minecraft.wiki/w/Sounds.json](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Sounds.json)
[https://github.com/misode/mcmeta/blob/assets/assets/minecraft/sounds.json](https://github.com/misode/mcmeta/blob/assets/assets/minecraft/sounds.json)

It’s okay to like or dislike C418’s music! Offering more options helps make the game better for a wider range of players.

there’s no need to be upset just because someone created a resource pack that removes C418’s music. **In fact, there are already plenty of packs that remove other artists and only keep C418’s tracks!**

So it’s completely fair if someone feels that C418’s music is too heavy or sad for their taste and wants a more relaxed gameplay experience.
